scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build --mode api --outDir node_modules/.tmp/admin-api-dist && vite build --mode firebase
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests e2e e2e-api playwright.config.ts playwright.api.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests e2e e2e-api playwright.config.ts playwright.api.config.ts
scripts.e2e:api: cp ../firebase-database-rules.json e2e/.database.rules.json && firebase emulators:exec --config e2e/firebase.json --project demo-tw "playwright test -c playwright.api.config.ts"
